title: Hummingbird VPC Launch — Ops Sprint Prep (weekly)
body:
Context:
- Customer: Hummingbird Analytics (private deployment / VPC + on-prem collector).
- Objective for this weekly ops sync: align on network gating items, finalize preflight checklist for pilot cluster (week-of-03/23 launch window), assign owners for remaining infra tasks.
- This doc = prep notes + running action item list. Keep lightweight; capture decisions and owners.

Attendees (planned):
- Elijah Hartman (me) — SE lead / primary contact
- Maya Kapoor — Deployment engineer (onprem package lead)
- Tomoko Sato — NetEng (VPC/peering/firewalls)
- Noah Chen — Security (KMS/HSM & certs)
- Rhea Patel — Customer success (schedule + acceptance criteria)
- Customer: Arjun (platform), Mei (netops), Claire (security) — sometimes asynchronous

Meeting agenda (15-30m):
1) Quick status (60s each)
2) Top 3 blockers today (live triage)
3) Confirm owners + deadlines for pilot gating items
4) Risk review: network + secret handling + infra scale test
5) AOB / next steps

Milestones (high level):
- Preflight complete (internal): target 2026-03-18 — verify connectivity, cert issuance, image signing.
- Pilot cluster deployed in customer lab (air-gapped collector + VPC peering verified): target 2026-03-22
- Pilot smoke tests (latency, throughput, failover): 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-25
- Production rollout window (tentative): 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-10

Current status snapshot (as of last run):
- Networking: VPC peering config drafted; customer ACLs pending; BGP not required for pilot.
- Secrets: KMS access configured but HSM provisioning still in customer backlog.
- Images: Signed images built; registry mirror planning took longer (mirror proxy config in progress).
- Observability: Basic tracing enabled; token-level cost telemetry still not wired into customer's Prometheus.

Top blockers (for this week) + suggested mitigations:
1) Customer firewall policy is blocking ephemeral port range used by collector-heartbeat (32000-33000).
   - Impact: collector can't establish outbound stream to hosted control plane for licensing handshake (will prevent telemetry and health checks).
   - Owner: Tomoko Sato to propose firewall rule exception template by 2026-03-13.
   - Mitigation: temporary SSH bastion channel + port-forward for pilot if rules cannot be changed in time.

2) HSM integration delayed (customer procurement) — without HSM we must fall back to KMS symmetric keys and document differences for compliance.
   - Impact: security signoff may be delayed; certain features (client-side attestation) gated.
   - Owner: Noah Chen to draft compliance note and fallback plan by 2026-03-15; Rhea to surface to customer procurement.

3) Registry mirror proxy performance not validated under peak throughput.
   - Impact: initial image pull for nodes may timeout, delaying bootstrap.
   - Owner: Maya to run mirror stress test (2 concurrent pulls x 10 nodes) and report by 2026-03-14.
   - Mitigation: pre-push necessary images to local registry in customer lab as stopgap.

4) Autoscaler config for Dedicated-like behavior not fully tested on their on-prem GPUs.
   - Impact: under load we may see OOM or suboptimal throughput.
   - Owner: Elijah to coordinate SRE runbook + performance test plan; target 2026-03-18 for recommended tuning.

Open action items (live tracker) — format: [action] — owner — due 
- [Draft firewall template + example rules for Hummingbird airflow] — Tomoko Sato — 2026-03-13
- [Fallback HSM -> KMS runbook; dataflow diagram] — Noah Chen — 2026-03-15
- [Mirror stress test + log collection] — Maya Kapoor — 2026-03-14
- [Push signed images to customer local registry and validate checksum] — Customer Ops / Elijah — 2026-03-16
- [End-to-end smoke test plan (scripts + acceptance criteria)] — Rhea Patel + Elijah — 2026-03-17
- [Create short "what to expect" slide for customer pilot kickoff] — Rhea Patel — 2026-03-18
- [Confirm IP CIDRs and NAT behavior for peering] — Customer (Mei) + Tomoko — 2026-03-13

Notes to self / things to surface in the meeting:
- Bring concrete examples of previous customer HSM fallback text used for legal review (helps expedite Noah's doc).
- Ask customer to prioritize HSM procurement vs signed-attestation features: which is critical for pilot?
- Recommend we run the mirror stress test from a separate network (to simulate their lab bandwidth constraints).
- Prepare a single-page "launch checklist" PDF to share at the end of meeting with the agreed owners/dates (Rhea to publish).

Risk register (short):
- R1: Procurement delay (HSM) -> Milestone slip by up to 3 weeks. Contingency: documented KMS fallback + limited feature matrix.
- R2: Network changes take longer than expected -> use SSH bastion fallback, but increases manual work and risk for scale.
- R3: Image pull failures in-airgapped -> node bootstrap instability; mitigate with pre-pushed images.

Customer questions we need answered before pilot:
- Can we get a firm commitment on HSM ETA (procurement ticket id)?
- Any corporate maintenance windows in late March that would block our pilot test window?
- Which team owns the local registry (ops or platform)? Contact name?

Prep checklist for the meeting (what I'll share live):
- One-slide timeline showing milestones + owners
- Short summary of each blocker + proposed mitigation (so we can make decisions quickly)
- Action item template (owner, due date, acceptance criteria)
- Link to stress-test logs and preflight checklist in Confluence

Post-meeting protocol:
- I will update this doc with any new owners/dates within 24 hours.
- Rhea to push final action list into JIRA and tag the customer contact.
- Schedule 30m focused follow-up mid-week if any critical items remain unresolved.

Unresolved / questions for Arjun/Mei:
- Can the customer enable ephemeral port range change for the pilot, or do we need to use bastion?
- Is there an internal change advisory board approval required for pre-pushing signed images?

Quick blunt assessment (private note):
- We are in a "soft gate" state  mostly config tweaks and procurement. No code-level blockers. If we keep the HSM procurement from slipping, pilot is feasible. If HSM slips and customer demands attestation, scope escalates.

Next sync: weekly standup same time next Thursday (2026-03-19) unless we need an earlier escalation call.

-- Elijah
